data.name: Asif
data.gender_notes: Asif is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-س-ف (ʿ-s-f); ʿĀṣif means 'forgiving' or 'skilled'. Its root is ع-س-ف (ʿ-s-f). A common Muslim given name. Asif is a Arabic name meaning “Forgiving; pardoner”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asif expresses “Forgiving; pardoner”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-س-ف (ʿ-s-f); ʿĀṣif means 'forgiving' or 'skilled'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asif total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
